payload.id: uuid — the battlemap, when the command names no target; never written
payload.size: number — the hex size in image pixels; strictly above 0 (grid-values-range)
payload.ox: number — the grid's horizontal offset in image pixels
payload.oy: number — the grid's vertical offset in image pixels
payload.opacity: number — a fraction of 1, from 0 to 1 (grid-values-range); any other field, the feet per hex first, is refused
